plugin.description: Unlocks the camera zoom-out limit and restores the original setting when disabled.
no_game: Open the game before checking the camera.
incompatible: The camera signature is missing, ambiguous or incompatible. No changes were made.
changed: The camera code changed. The operation was cancelled.
status.idle: Extended zoom is disabled. Open the game to check compatibility.
status.waiting: Custom limits are saved. Waiting to enter the game before activating.
status.ready: Compatible camera detected. Extended zoom can be enabled.
status.restored: Original camera limit restored. Scroll the wheel to move the camera closer if necessary.
status.failed: Activation or compatibility check failed. Toggle activation off and on to retry.
status.restore_failed: Restoration failed. Try disabling extended zoom again; restarting the game restores the original camera.
invalid_distance: Invalid camera distance. Extended zoom has been stopped.
help: Enable custom limits, then use the game’s mouse wheel. To retain these limits without ExileCenter, install the autonomous camera once with the game closed. Subsequent saved changes here are synchronized automatically.
limits_help: 100% is the original zoom-out limit. The autonomous camera retains both limits without ExileCenter. The mouse wheel remains usable between them.
status.active: Custom limits are active. Use the game’s mouse wheel between both limits.
permanent_help: Install once with PoE closed. The component then starts with the game without ExileCenter. Limit changes are synchronized within one second. Disabling limits restores 0–100%. Close the game before removing the component.
status.permanent: Autonomous camera installed. Saved limits are used when PoE starts, even without ExileCenter.
